title: I'm only giving it four stars because it broke. ...
text:
I'm only giving it four stars because it broke. .... I'm only giving it four stars because it broke. Yes, I used it to peel and slice many pears but the screw inside came out so I opened it up, put everything back as it was supposed to go and it came loose on the next pear. I'll probably order another one anyway in hopes that it'll work out.

Update: Hubby was able to do a better repair on the item, possibly due to the fact that my hands were full of gooey pear juice when I tried to repair. It's back to working great! As I said before, I would have ordered another one since it makes peeling so much easier for people who can their own apples and/or pears or any other reason you need to peel lots of fruit.

product_metadata.title: Johnny Apple Peeler (VKP1011), Clamp Base, Stainless Steel Blades, Red
features: QUICK AND EASY: Peel, core and slice any apple variety. The key to the fastest apple pie or crisp!
EASY TO ADJUST: Coring/slicing blade can be removed. Peeling blade can be adjusted for a thick or thin peel
BUILT TO LAST: All blades are stainless steel. Heavy duty cast iron body.
STRONG CLAMP BASE: Keeps the peeler securely in place on the edge of any table or countertop up to 1-5/8” thick
description: The Johnny Apple Peeler will peel, slice, and core at the same time by simply turning the crank handle. It is the perfect kitchen tool for all varieties of apples and it's also a great time saver. The Johnny Apple Peeler combines three steps into one: peel, slice and core. Place an apple on the fork, turn the handle and let the Johnny Apple Peeler do the work for you. The stainless steel blades will peel, slice and core the apple as the handle turns. The result is even, 1/4" slices that are ready to eat, dehydrate or use in a recipe. The adjustable peeling blade will cut as much or as little of the peel as you'd like. The peeling blade can also be locked out of the way if non-peeled slices are desired. The all-in-one slicing and coring blade can be removed if you don't want to core or slice but just want to peel. The tension on the peeling arm is controlled by a spring so it conforms to the shape of the apple or potato giving you a perfect peel every time. The durable, cast iron body is longer than other peelers to better handle larger apples or potatoes. The convenient clamp base mounts to tables or counters up to 1-5/8 inches thick. A rubber pad guards against marring.
